insight: Raised a $36M Series A led by a16z at a $150M valuation in Oct 2024; angels include Greg Brockman and Guillermo Rauch.
name: Braintrust
tagline: Hosted eval + tracing platform for LLM apps.
description: Production-grade eval orchestration with a dashboard, dataset versioning, and OpenTelemetry tracing. Useful once eval volume outgrows a CI YAML file.
edge: Eval-first: prompts are versioned objects and CI scorers block a merge when quality regresses.
pros: Eval workflow as the primary interface
CI scorers block merges on regression
cons: Overkill for tiny single-file eval needs

references.title: LLM Eval Tools Compared 2026: Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize
